# Secure Terminal
The Secure Terminal is a system built into the station's [color=#ffd700]Main Communications Console[/color]. It gives command staff a formal way to request and authorise major decisions; things like calling Emergency Response Teams, escalating the station's alert level, or deploying emergency armories.
Every request made through this system is announced to the station, and in most cases requires multiple people to co-authorize before anything happens.
## Starting a Request
Only someone who holds the correct access can open a proposal. There are typically two [color=#ffd700]Main Communications Consoles[/color] on the station where requests can be started; one on the [bold]Bridge[/bold] and one in the [bold]Captain's office[/bold]. Either works.
In the Main Communications Console, select 'Secure Terminal' to begin. From there you will see a list of available requests. Select the one relevant to the situation, provide a reason if prompted, and submit it. The terminal will immediately notify all Keycard Authentication Devices on the station that a proposal is pending, and a countdown will begin for co-authorizers to respond.
Keep in mind:
- Only [bold]one proposal[/bold] can be active at a time. - Most requests have a [bold]fee[/bold] drawn from your account when submitted; this is held until the proposal resolves. - Certain requests are [bold]one-time-use[/bold] per shift and cannot be re-submitted once used.
## Co-Authorization
Most requests require more than one person to approve them before anything happens. This is where the [color=#ffd700]Keycard Authentication Devices[/color] come in.
The Captain and Every head of staff has one of these devices installed in their office. When a proposal is active, the authentication device will light up [color=blue]blue[/color]. A co-authorizer can walk up to it, and add their authorization to the pending request.
All Keycard Authentication Devices on the station are identical; they are not tied to a specific head of staff. Any command member with the right access can walk up to [italic]any[/italic] device, regardless of whose office it is in, and use it to co-authorize a pending proposal.
Each [color=#ffd700]Main Communications Console[/color] and each [color=#ffd700]Keycard Authentication Device[/color] can only contribute [bold]one authorization per request[/bold]. Once a device has been used to authorise a proposal, it is locked out for that request; a second person cannot use the same device to co-authorize and will need to find a different [color=#ffd700]Keycard Authentication Device[/color] or [color=#ffd700]Main Communications Console[/color].
Additionally, each individual command member can only authorize [bold]once per request[/bold].
Once all required co-authorizations are collected, the terminal begins its activation countdown. The request will then activate automatically when the timer runs out, unless it requires approval from Central Command.
If the timer for collecting co-authorizations runs out before everyone has authorized, the proposal is cancelled and any held fee is refunded. As a general rule, you have [bold]30 seconds[/bold] to get everyone to co-authorize, though certain requests (such as the Nuclear Response Team) have no co-authorization time limit.
## A Few Things Worth Knowing
- [bold]Canceling a request[/bold] can be done by any command member through the console; not just the person who started it. - Some requests require [bold]Central Command[/bold] approval before they activate, regardless of how many command staff have authorized. If no Central Command members are available, certain requests will bypass this and proceed automatically. - Armories and pods can be [bold]recalled[/bold] if they block evac or are no longer needed, once a short cooldown has elapsed. - If both consoles are destroyed or otherwise unavailable, the Captain's locker contains a [bold]Communications Computer Board[/bold] that can be used to build a replacement. - If the terminal cannot be used at all, a [bold]fax[/bold] to Central Command is the next best option. As a last resort, the [bold]red phone[/bold] in the Captain's office provides a direct line, though this should only be used if nothing else is available.
